title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.28601v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWor

translated_abstract: 计算机使用型智能体受限于人类赋予它们的接口。当一行代码就能完成操作时，智能体可能会逐个单元格地填写电子表格；或者为了寻找一个函数，通过 shell 打印出文件的全部两千行内容。无论是这些接口本身，还是关于何时使用何种接口的知识，目前都是人工构建的，这无法跟上新应用、新工作流和新模型的发展步伐。我们认为，接口设计本身应当成为一种智能体能力。我们提出了 Agent S4，一个自主的计算机使用科学家，它能够从任务经验中构建演化式智能体接口。一个元智能体在没有成功标签的合成训练任务上分析任务智能体的运行轨迹，并在仓库中构建和修订接口及其使用知识。随后，基于种群的演化根据各仓库在元智能体从未见过的验证任务上的表现，选择哪些仓库值得进一步开发，从而偏爱那些能够泛化到已见任务之外的有效改进。在 OSWorld（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出 Agent S4，一种能从任务经验中自主构建并演化智能体接口的计算机使用科学家，将接口设计本身变成一种智能体能力，以突破人工设计接口的局限。
en_tdlr: Agent S4 is an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds and evolves agent interfaces from task experience, turning interface design itself into an agent capability to overcome the limits of hand-crafted interfaces.
